_about: Level 2's animation frames the user removed (the frame chooser, tools/msxchooser.py), for
tools/msxsprites.py --pool --l2-remove. Empty: every new level-2 frame is kept until the user
chooses (the level-2 plan's default 38). bob: 'addr:w:h' (hex) of a frame only level 2 draws ->
[the frame shown instead, dy, dx], or null: a frame the level never draws. The frames level 2
shares with level 1 follow msx/level1_frames.json, and RoboCop's ('rc') are chosen there only.
